about_the_game:
Pale Incense

A gothic adventure about love, immortality, and sacrifice.
Play as Edmund, a vampire perfumer who hunts by night to save the dying soul of his beloved wife.
Craft perfumes from human essences, manage your shop by day, and survive the deadly streets by night.

Story

Born from the shadows of a cursed life, the vampire Edmund falls in love with Johanna, an innocent florist — and to his surprise, his love is returned. They marry and build a happy life together.
But as time passes, Edmund begins to feel a deep sorrow and helplessness within. Johanna is human, and her life will one day end. Losing her is something he cannot bear. Desperate to keep her by his side forever, he lets Johanna drink his blood, granting her his own immortality. Now, she too will be a vampire — and together, they will share eternity.

However, things do not go as planned. Before long, Johanna’s delicate body fails to endure the transformation. She grows deathly ill and becomes bedridden. As her skin pales more each day, Edmund realizes that the only way to save his beloved is to turn her back into a human.
Determined to find a cure, he decides to use his most powerful vampiric trait — his extraordinary sense of smell.

Thanks to this gift, Edmund runs a perfume shop filled with unique fragrances he creates — for he is not only a vampire but also an alchemist. Now, he will use his perfumery and alchemy skills to heal the woman he loves.
Each night, he hunts humans to collect their essence — the final breath of his victims — believing it may hold the key to restoring Johanna’s humanity. This “human essence” is captured within mystical vampire stones, from which he crafts enchanted incense in his laboratory. Each day, he burns the incense by Johanna’s bedside, and as she breathes it in, he sees a faint light of life returning to her.

But the nights grow harsher. Edmund must face relentless enemies, gather as many vampire stones as he can, and fight to survive — all while sacrificing others in a desperate attempt to bring his wife back to life.

By Day: The Perfume Shop

  • In your laboratory, craft various fragrance types from human essences — and from these fragrances, create unique perfumes.

  • Serve customers, sell perfumes, and earn money to grow your shop.

  • Upgrade your equipment, unlock new recipes, and expand your storage.

  • Use your earnings to customize your vampire lair below the shop.

  • Daytime is not endless. Once time runs out, no more customers will come, and the streets will call you back to the hunt.

The Vampire Lair

  • Beneath your shop lies your hidden refuge — a sanctuary for you and your dying wife.

  • Use the magical human stones you gather to craft healing incense and keep Johanna alive.

  • If you fail to burn this incense each day, Johanna will be one step closer to death.

  • Upgrade your vampire bed to reduce nightly hunger and health loss.

  • Convert vampire stones into Vampire Reputation to unlock new vampire skills so you can assign them to your ability slots.

By Night: The District

  • Wander through a gothic city filled with danger and prey.

  • Hunt and feed on humans to survive — if your hunger drops too low, your health will begin to drain.

  • Search for hidden chests containing rare vampire stones.

  • Combine vampire stones with the human essences collected from your victims’ corpses to create magical human stones.

  • Hide corpses to avoid alerting the townsfolk.

  • Stealth is essential. If too many people witness your horrific acts, the district will enter lockdown, and the streets will empty for a time.

  • Face relentless enemies:

    • The Scrooge Brothers, vampire hunters who track you anywhere except the “Back Alley.”

    • A mysterious rooftop archer, striking without warning.

    • A feral werewolf lurking in the “Back Alley,” far stronger than you — flee on sight.

  • Night is not endless. Before dawn, reach the boat waiting by the river — or the first light of day will burn you, and death will be inevitable.

Features

  • Deep alchemy and perfume crafting system, featuring 30 types of scents and 20 unique perfumes to create

  • Dual gameplay: shop management by day, survival and hunting by night

  • A variety of vampire abilities

  • A tragic vampire love story

  • Reactive district system with panic, alerts, and lockdown phases

  • Lair customization and upgrade mechanics

  • Intense encounters with hunters, the archer, and werewolf

  • A dark gothic atmosphere

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD RX 580 (8 GB)

  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Supports Stereo Sound

short_description: You’re trying to maintain two lives as a vampire. By day, you run your perfume shop; by night, you roam the city streets, hunting to survive. But the nights won’t be as easy as you thought. Both lives are bound by a single purpose, to save your fading beloved wife.
